newsitem.title: PERU: Peru wholesale prices rise 0.78 percent in August.
newsitem.headline: Peru wholesale prices rise 0.78 percent in August.

text.p: Peru's wholesale prices rose 0.78 percent in August, up from 0.70 percent in the same month last year and down slightly from 0.92 percent in July, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Monday.
In the first eight months of 1996, wholesale prices rose 7.46 percent, up from from 6.6 percent in the same period of 1995.
Wholesale prices rose 9.72 percent in the last 12 months up to August.
In 1995, accumulated inflation for wholesale prices was 8.8 percent, up from 10.5 percent the previous year.
Earlier, the INEI said that Peru's consumer prices rose 0.92 percent in August this year, and 8.84 percent in the first eight months of 1996.
Consumer inflation was led by a 1.3 percent rise in medical costs and a 1.2 percent rise in food and drink.
Consumer prices rose 11.77 percent in the last 12 months up to August, the INEI added.
